verdict.rationale: The product is the Gemini API itself. Documentation covers the REST API, official SDKs in Python, JS/TS, Go and Java, OpenAI-library compatibility, function calling, Batch and Live APIs, and a full WebhookService REST reference, so programmatic control is clearly delivered. Community reports confirm real use of GenerateContent calls. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probed openapi/swagger paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Unlock AI capabilities for your apps with a simple call to the Gemini API.
The Google GenAI SDK is available for the Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go and Java languages.

You'll make your first API call in under a minute and explore text generation, multimodal understanding, image generation, structured output, tools, function calling, agents, and background execution.
The Gemini Batch API is designed to process large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% of the standard cost.
